title: Lark chat archive to governed distillation handoff
scope: Move NAS Lark chat archives into reviewable assistant distillation and Obsidian memory governance candidates without putting full archives into prompt context.

acceptance_criteria.description: The handoff scans NAS JSONL records under knowledge/Chat/Lark Chat and groups records by Chinese department, employee, and day.
The handoff can generate pending assistant_distillation candidates from repeated tone or intent feedback found in archived Lark chats.
The handoff exports day-level need_review governed memory notes into Obsidian 40_MemoryGovernance/Inbox with source_path/source_hash evidence.
The worker exposes Lark archive handoff flags so cron can run the distillation path without a separate script.

non_goals: Do not inject full archived chat transcripts into LLM prompts.
Do not auto-approve governed memories or assistant language candidates.
Do not require an LLM to run the first production handoff.
